rules.answer: The customer said they are on Sandbox 2.8.0, a single server install that has not been upgraded in about four months (seg_004).

Here is a more formal version:

<email>
Dear Hannah,

Thank you for your time today. Your analysis queue is stalled because the data drive is about 96 percent full, and the Sandbox log reports not enough free disk space to start a new analysis. Please send a breakdown of folder sizes on the data drive today, and refrain from deleting anything by hand until you receive the documented cleanup steps. I will send those steps and confirm which items are safe to remove.

Kind regards,
Luca Bianchi
</email>

Most likely next step: get the folder size breakdown from the customer, free space with the documented cleanup, then confirm the queue starts moving again. Source: Sandbox: managing disk usage and data retention https://docs.example-opswat.invalid/sandbox/administration/disk-usage-retention. Related: SUP-52718 (queued analyses not started when free disk space is low).

arguments.query: Sandbox queue stalled low free disk space cleanup

rules.answer: The log reports not enough free disk space to start a new analysis. The documented way to free space is described at https://docs.example-opswat.invalid/sandbox/administration/disk-usage-retention, and retention is covered at https://docs.example-opswat.invalid/sandbox/configuration/results-retention.

arguments.query: Sandbox queue not started low free disk space

rules.answer: SUP-52718 covers queued analyses that do not start while free disk space is low; the queue resumes after space is freed. For the unused analysis VM images, see https://docs.example-opswat.invalid/sandbox/administration/vm-images.
